steps.title: ApprovalGate options and rules
steps.note: The gate is initialized with auto-rules, a default timeout of 120s, and optional callbacks for request/result events. These hooks are how the Cowork UI surfaces approval requests to operators.

steps.title: Requesting an approval
steps.note: When a tool call arrives, request() first checks auto-rules. If no rule matches, it stores a pending promise with a timer and notifies the UI via onRequest. Timeouts resolve to a 'timeout' decision so the agent cannot hang forever.

steps.title: Human response and result propagation
steps.note: respond() lets an operator approve or reject a pending action. It clears the timer, removes the entry, and calls onResult so the audit layer can record the decision.

steps.title: Default low-risk auto-approval
steps.note: buildDefaultRules() auto-approves low-risk actions. Teams can extend this with org-specific rules, but high-risk actions like file writes outside the workspace or network calls always escalate to humans.
